description: The history of IBANs seen for a supplier: which are confirmed, which are awaiting human confirmation, which were rejected, and since when. It is the memory a new IBAN is judged against. IBANs are MASKED (country, bank, last 4 digits). Requires an API key (free account at https://imperioutils.com/signup). Consumes no credits.

partita_iva.description: Supplier's Italian VAT number (Partita IVA, with or without IT prefix).

vat_number.description: Alias of `partita_iva` (Italian VAT number): the same value, accepted because other tools of this server use this name. If you send both names, the values must match.
